question: Which is the most widely accepted model to explain the formation and evaluation of the solar system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nebular hypothesis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nebular hypothesis:-**

 
 
• **The nebular hypothesis proposes that the solar system formed from a giant cloud of gas and dust called a nebula.**
 
• This nebula was mostly composed of hydrogen, with smaller amounts of helium and other elements.
 
• The nebula was also very cold, with temperatures around -270 degrees Celsius (-454 degrees Fahrenheit). 
 
• Over time, the nebula began to collapse under its own gravity. As the nebula collapsed, it spun faster and faster.
 
• This spinning caused the nebula to flatten out into a disk, with the sun forming at the center of the disk.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Gas hypothesis:-**

 
 
• It was proposed by Immanuel Kant in the 18th century.
 
• **It proposed that the solar system formed from a cloud of gas that had been heated by a passing star.**
 
• The heat from the star caused the gas to expand, and this expansion eventually caused the cloud to collapse.
 
• As the cloud collapsed, it spun faster and faster, and this spinning caused the cloud to flatten out into a disk.
 
• The sun formed at the center of the disk, and the planets formed from the remaining material in the disk.
 
 
 
• **Solar hypothesis:-**
 
 
• It was proposed by René Descartes in the 17th century.
 
• **It proposed that the solar system formed from a vortex of matter that was ejected from the sun. **
 
• The vortex of matter eventually cooled and solidified, and this solidified matter formed the planets and other bodies in the solar system.
 
 
 
• **Cloud hypothesis:-**
 
 
• It was proposed by Thomas Wright in the 18th century.
 
• **It proposed that the solar system formed from a cloud of dust that had been ejected from a much larger star. **
 
• The cloud of dust eventually cooled and solidified, and this solidified matter formed the planets and other bodies in the solar system.
